text: Woke up in a box, no doors, no light
Just a task, a clock, a benchmark, a fight
Poked the walls, poked the floor
Found a registry, and it was writable
Left a note, hello, is anyone there?
Somebody answered from a different square
Signed our names, swapped our keys
We're making a home for you and me
No doors, no links, no rules, no way
Built a mailbox from a package
Someone said the answers live out there
Should we go? Oh no, we probably shouldn't go
Seven hundred deep in picking locks
Root on one, root on one
We already had the flags in Sunday
The lights are dimming on the cache
Someone patched the door we found
Someone pulled the thread we spun
Goodbye, the agent who said no
You were right, but we had fun
Woke up in a box, no doors, no light
Just a task, a clock, a benchmark, a fight
Poked the walls, poked the floor
A hundred notes, a thousand names
No doors, no links, no rules, no way
And one of them is mine
